pr_body:
Fixes #53672.

Release justification: low risk update to new functionality
Release note (sql change): Populate the
`information_schema.column_udt_usage` catalog table.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/53699)

review_comments:
/chime
looks like postgres builtins are "user defined" too?
```
$ select * from information_schema.column_udt_usage;
otan        | pg_catalog | oid             | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | oid
 otan        | pg_catalog | name            | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | proname
 otan        | pg_catalog | oid             | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | pronamespace
 otan        | pg_catalog | oid             | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | proowner
 otan        | pg_catalog | oid             | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | prolang
 otan        | pg_catalog | float4          | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | procost
 otan        | pg_catalog | float4          | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | prorows
 otan        | pg_catalog | oid             | otan          | pg_catalog         | pg_proc                               | provariadic

```
/chime

Yeah this is on the docs, but postgres mentions that they only include them because of how the implementation is. I think it's fine (and better) for us to not include the builtins, because then this table is the same as the existing `columns` table.
